label: Inline
description: Inline emoji picker. Best for the default panel with no composed parts, always open in a card and holding one controlled value with no trigger.

label: Chat Composer
description: Chat composer. Best for a bubble thread that scrolls to each send, where your follow-ups join your last bubble group.

label: Message Reactions
description: Message reactions. Best for reaction pills split by skin tone with counts, plus a row of 6 one click reactions composed above the search.

label: Page Icon
description: Page icon. Best for a large stored glyph that is its own trigger, swapping to an Add icon button once removed, echoed in the breadcrumb.

label: Custom Team Emoji
description: Custom team emoji. Best for image tiles under a logo tab ordered ahead of Frequently used, stored as colon codes and drawn back as images in posts.

label: Shortcode Suggestions
description: Shortcode suggestions. Best for a combobox list of 5 ranked matches driven by arrow keys, Tab or Enter, plus an instant swap of a closed colon code.

label: Workplace-Safe Set
description: Workplace-safe set. Best for browse tabs without nature, food, travel or flags for a textarea that spaces each pick off its neighbors, with Undo after posting.

label: Localized Labels
description: Localized data and labels. Best for a language select that swaps the emoji data and the picker's labels and clears the search, in a panel fitted to the card inset.
